name: DeepSeek-R1
tagline: Open-weight reasoning LLM runnable locally via distilled 7B and 8B checkpoints
real_test_summary: Ran deepseek-r1:8b Q4_K_M on macOS M2 16GB RAM at ~31 tokens/sec with full visible reasoning trace and zero cloud telemetry.
pros: MIT license allows unrestricted commercial deployment
Distilled 7B/8B models fit inside 6GB VRAM or 8GB Apple Silicon
Strong step-by-step math and coding reasoning
cons: Reasoning traces generate more tokens per answer
Full 671B model requires enterprise multi-GPU clusters
description: Chain-of-thought reasoning model released under MIT license with compact distilled Qwen and Llama weights capable of solving math, coding, and logic tasks completely offline.
